That which is especially auxiliary in the accomplishment of the action, of the verb दिव् 'to play' is called कर्म - object, as well as करण।

Terms: कारक-करण

The object of the verb दिव् when having the above-mentioned sense of 'dealing' or 'stalking', takes the 6th-Case.

Terms: विभक्ति-6

The affix श्यन् comes after a root of the दिवादि class when a सार्वधातुक affix denoting the agent follows.

Terms: श्यन्

The affix ट comes after the verb कृञ् 'to make' when the following words are in composition with it - 1. दिवा 'by day' 2. विभा 'light' 3. निशा 'night' 4. प्रभा 'splendour' 5. भाः 'light' 6. कार 'work' 7. अन्त 'end' 8. अनन्त 'endless' 9. आदि 'beginning' 10. बहु 'many' 11. नान्दी 'benediction' 12. किम् 'what' 13. लिपि 'writing' 14. लिबि 'writing' 15. बलि 'oblation' 16. भक्ति 'devotion' 17. कर्तृ 'agent' 18. चित्र 'painting' 19. क्षेत्र 'field' 20. संख्या - words denoting numerals 21. जङ्घा 'thigh' 22. बाहु 'hand' 23. अहः 'day' 24. यत् 'what' 25. तत् 'that' 26. धनुस् 'bow' 27. अरुस् 'wound'.

Terms: ट
For the final of the nominal-stem दिव् , there is the substitution of उ , when it is a पद (

After दिव् a case-ending beginning with भ or स is unaccented.

Terms: accent-विभक्ति

For दिव् is substituted द्यावा in a द्वन्द समास of names of देवता-s.

Terms: विभक्ति-Non-elision

For दिव् is also substituted दिवस् (as well as a द्यावा) when पृथिवी follows in a द्वन्द समास of names of देवता-s.

Terms: विभक्ति-Non-elision

औ is substituted for the final of दिव् before the affix सु (Nominative 1st-Case and Vocative Case singular).

Terms: Some substitution

The निष्ठा त is changed to न after दिव् when the sense is not that of 'play'.

Terms: निष्ठा changes
